Methodology: the field is every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for San Francisco dance searches on 14 Oct 2026. The Bay Area is split into five pages: San Francisco, Oakland (East Bay), San Jose (South Bay), Fremont (south Alameda County and the Tri-Valley) and San Mateo (the Peninsula). ChatGPT also named Melifolla Dance, which didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Each studio's site was crawled and graded across seven categories (AI readiness, SEO basics, page structure, content depth, social, image alt text, technical) on the same day. Google local positions come from four searches (ballroom dance lessons san francisco ca, dance lessons san francisco ca, salsa lessons san francisco ca and wedding dance lessons san francisco ca). AI visibility reflects live sessions in the public ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI apps, asked the two queries shown above; presence was confirmed by reading each engine's raw answer directly. This is an independent measurement by Ballroom Dance Directory, not commissioned by any studio named above. Rankings reflect a point-in-time snapshot and will be re-run periodically. The complete scorecard, Google table and AI answers are in the detailed report.

details.html:
0 of 12STUDIOS EARN AN A
FOR AI READINESS

Twelve studios compete for San Francisco's dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 12 dance and ballroom studios serving the San Francisco market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 38 to 94. The AI engines name only seven of the 12. The field averages 60 (D) on AI readiness, 10 of 12 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 9 of 12 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 14 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the San Francisco, CA area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 12 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Arthur Murray San Francisco (94) and Bachata Lab (92) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 38.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 60 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • Of the 12 studios, 10 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 9 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. Only one has both.
  • One of the 12 is a franchise location (one Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • One site in the field still isn't served over HTTPS — a critical flag browsers show visitors before they see a single class schedule.
  • The gap between #1 and #12 is 56 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in San Francisco.” Every AI mention went to a studio inside the city. Studios that serve San Francisco from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

The monthly SEO / AEO program

WhenFocusWhat happens
Month 1Fix what's broken; claim the open leverFAQ/Q&A schema, llms.txt, missing alt text and meta descriptions, thin pages, correct schema typing.
Month 2-3Broaden content to match how buyers askContent built around both the specialist and the generic query, and around the city buyers actually search.
OngoingOff-site signal buildingReviews, directory consistency, third-party mentions.
Every monthRe-measure all 3 engines, both queries, and the mapAI answers shift; a competitor closing this gap first changes the answer for everyone else.

Methodology & notes

Field (12 studios): arthurmurraylive.com/san-francisco, bachatalab.org, sfsalsaacademy.com, thedanceloftsf.com, missioncityswing.com, genesisdancesport.com, metronomesf.com, symbolicmambo.com, goldencitydance.com, thegrooveroomsf.com, margegabbert.com, pickdance.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 14 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for San Francisco dance searches. The Bay Area is split into five pages: San Francisco, Oakland (East Bay), San Jose (South Bay), Fremont (south Alameda County and the Tri-Valley) and San Mateo (the Peninsula). ChatGPT also named Melifolla Dance, which didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Left out: private instructors without a studio of their own (Wedding & Ballroom Dance with Richard, Jasmine Worrell, Emily Coles, Erin Parsley, Angie Major, Michelle's Swing Dance, Salsa by Ricardo, The World of Paz, Ballroom by Tiffany), venues and clubs (Verdi Club, Space 550 and Dance Fridays, SalsaCrazy, El Valenciano), Luminati Dance and Danzhaus (their sites no longer load), Ritmo Latino SF (no website of its own), Latin Jam's academy (Linktree only), contemporary, hip-hop, pole and youth studios that lead the broad answers (ODC, Rae Studios, City Dance, Dance Mission, Mood & Moves, Alonzo King LINES), and Dance Arts Ballroom in San Rafael (outside this area).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 14 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Arthur Murray) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in San Francisco, CA?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in San Francisco, CA?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's public web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 14 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons san francisco ca”; “dance lessons san francisco ca”; “salsa lessons san francisco ca”; “wedding dance lessons san francisco ca”; “ballroom dance lessons daly city ca”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in san francisco ca” and “ballroom dance studio san francisco”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
